text: The Bank of Korea raises its benchmark rate 25 bps to 3.25%, its highest in two years. October inflation stands at 2.8% against a 2% target, with Q3 GDP growth at 3.4% YoY. Growth forecasts are revised upward to 3.9% for 2026 and 4.1% for 2027.

meta.note: Revised growth forecasts represent institutional projections rather than realized economic output.

text: Norse Atlantic suspends all flights with short-term financing unsecured and bankruptcy filing conditional on funding availability. Shares close 85% lower Wednesday. Scheduled flights total 2,565 in 2026 versus 4,695 in 2025. Ticket sales remain accessible despite operational suspension.

meta.note: Collapse applies to operational integrity; legal insolvency and permanent cessation remain unresolved.
